title: callista perakensis
intro: Callista perakensis, commonly known as Callista, is a plant species that belongs to the Apocynaceae family. It is native to the tropical regions of Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been found to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. Bioactive constituents present in Callista perakensis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
